meta.title: Recreate Order: A past delivery date and an incomplete scheduled event show the app response
gaps: Whether a new order was created after each Create Order attempt.
The exact refusal or validation message when the application does not expose it as a field error or known message.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Whether a new order was created after each Create Order attempt.; The exact refusal or validation message when the application does not expose it as a field error or known message.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary as the buyer; the event and bid already exist.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Confirm the Recreate Order window opened.
Enter the specified past delivery date.
Check for a field-level refusal of the past delivery date without inventing message text.
Verify the dialog remains open after the invalid-date attempt.
Clear the delivery date for the second attempt.
Enable event scheduling while leaving the scheduled date and time empty.
Confirm the scheduled date remains empty with its placeholder.
Confirm the scheduled time remains empty with its placeholder.
Verify the recreate-order window remains open when required scheduling fields are empty.
